0022600038.text: The Pelicans host the Grizzlies in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, with New Orleans at 4-8 (3-4 at home) and 12th in the West, 6 games back in the Southwest after losing four straight. Memphis arrives at 7-4 (5-0 on the road) and 9th in the West, and the Pelicans lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 135-134 win in Memphis on November 2, following a 2-2 split in 2025-26. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), while Bennedict Mathurin, Trendon Watford and Trey Murphy III are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and Memphis is missing Richie Saunders (out, knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness), with Quinten Post day-to-day with a head injury.
